verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no eval runs, eval datasets, or scoring, and no side-by-side comparison of eval runs between prompt or model versions. The LLM Calls view lets users compare models, prompts, tokens, cost and response performance across production model requests. That is observability of live traffic, an adjacent feature rather than eval-run comparison for catching regressions.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions
